name: agentic-sop-kit
description: Convert human SOPs into deterministic agentic workflows — linear or as a bounded graph (typed handoff edges, unique field ownership, bounded back-edges, static topology validation). Bundles the six-rung-ladder + agentic-sop + agentic-workflow-audit skills, the /sop-flow command, a project-scoped Stop-hook regression gate, and the portable agentic-sop-kit.
